name: type_malformed_line
description: the CSV line could not be parsed into the 9 UCI columns (Bronze _corrupt_record)

name: key_date_time_missing
description: date_time (part of the business key station+hour) is missing

name: missing_traffic_volume
description: traffic_volume, the measured value, is missing

name: missing_weather_field
violation_expr: (temp IS NULL OR trim(temp) = '') OR (rain_1h IS NULL OR trim(rain_1h) = '') OR (snow_1h IS NULL OR trim(snow_1h) = '') OR (clouds_all IS NULL OR trim(clouds_all) = '') OR (weather_main IS NULL OR trim(weather_main) = '') OR (weather_description IS NULL OR trim(weather_description) = '')
description: one of the UCI weather fields is missing

name: type_traffic_volume
violation_expr: (traffic_volume IS NOT NULL AND trim(traffic_volume) <> '') AND NOT (trim(traffic_volume) RLIKE '^-?[0-9]+$')

name: type_weather_numeric
violation_expr: ((temp IS NOT NULL AND trim(temp) <> '') AND try_cast(trim(temp) AS DOUBLE) IS NULL) OR ((rain_1h IS NOT NULL AND trim(rain_1h) <> '') AND try_cast(trim(rain_1h) AS DOUBLE) IS NULL) OR ((snow_1h IS NOT NULL AND trim(snow_1h) <> '') AND try_cast(trim(snow_1h) AS DOUBLE) IS NULL) OR ((clouds_all IS NOT NULL AND trim(clouds_all) <> '') AND try_cast(trim(clouds_all) AS DOUBLE) IS NULL)
description: temp, rain_1h, snow_1h or clouds_all is not numeric

name: ts_unparseable
violation_expr: (date_time IS NOT NULL AND trim(date_time) <> '') AND hour_start_local IS NULL
description: date_time does not match yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss on the hour

name: ts_dst_nonexistent
description: local time does not exist in America/Chicago (spring-forward gap)

name: ts_dst_ambiguous
description: local time occurs twice in America/Chicago (fall-back hour); UTC hour is uncertain

name: ts_outside_coverage
description: timestamp outside the documented source period 2012-01-01 00:00:00 .. 2018-12-31 23:00:00

name: range_volume_zero
description: traffic_volume is 0 vehicles/hour (possible outage or closure)

name: unique_hour_conflicting_volume
description: several source rows for one hour disagree on traffic_volume

name: unique_hour_conflicting_weather
description: several source rows for one hour disagree on a numeric weather field; that field is set to NULL
